heading: Court of the United States defined
lead: As used in this title, except where otherwise expressly provided 2 the term “court of the United States” includes the District Court of Guam, the District Court for the Northern Mariana Islands, and the District Court of the Virgin Islands.
sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 103–322, title XXXII, § 320914(a), Sept. 13, 1994, 108 Stat. 2128.)
